reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume has roughly doubled since August (≈600/month → 1180-1260/month, F-05/E-05), and 59% (1785/3025) of disputed bills carry an ACTUAL (accepted) read type versus 41% ESTIMATED (F-02/E-02), showing most wrong bills originate downstream of read acquisition, in the billing import/validation step that processes accepted reads, not primarily from missed/estimated reads. The best-supported, uncontradicted candidate mechanism is a billing import validation rule change introduced around August (H-BILLING-RULE-CHANGE) causing accepted reads to be mis-processed into incorrect bills; tariff-rate change (F-04/E-04) and dispute-response latency (F-03/E-03) are ruled out as mechanisms. A moderate field manual-read route-completion shortfall (0.88 vs 0.95 target, F-01/E-01) separately explains part of the minority (41%) estimate-type disputes but is not the primary driver of the surge.
